Comment: Easy to understand

Binary output issue
* According to the contribution guidelines, binary outputs should be avoided for clashes. That's exactly the issue with your clash, as it allows only two possible answers (either "VALID" or "INVALID"). Please modify the output requirement to allow for more than two possible answers.

Formatting / presentation
* Please study the formatting syntax described on this page: https://www.codingame.com/playgrounds/40701/help-center/statement , and format your statement properly as described in the points below.

Goal / Input
* Please change HH:MM to [[HH]]{{:}}[[MM]].

Output
* Please format "VALID" and "INVALID" as {{constants}}.

Constraints
* Please format "HH" and "MM" as [[variables]].

Cases
* Please be reminded that each test and its validator should cover the same scenario but with slightly different inputs (and slightly different outputs where applicable).

* I'll review the cases after the task has been updated.

Title
* Consider revising the title to minimise confusion.

Thanks.
